featured_reviews.name: Vinu Vijayan
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are in Lower Parel around Phoenix mill then Rolling Pins is definitely worth a visit.

This all veg bakery is hard to miss with its see through glass and signboards all over.

We were here for an evening snack and relished on some delicacies :

- Cappuccino :  Hot & Perfect and much needed for the evening to be complete.

- High Protein Shake : Loved this milkshake made with vegan milk mixed along with plant based proteins and topped with chocolate powder.

- Avacado toast on Rye bread : My all tim time favorite! Crispy toast with a layer of hummus spread topped with freshly cut avocado 🥑 slices - Loved it!

- Tandoori Paneer Peinirli : Oval shaped pizza with loads of cheese & paneer cube toppings - Delicious😋

- Butter Croissant : Simple yet Satiating with subtle hints of butter in each bite, one can opt for cheese or Nutella fillings as well.

- Spinach Corn Quiche : Definitely a delicacy, loads of spinach & corn stuffed inside a tart.

- Baked Cheesecake : This could have been better, was a bit too thick in texture.

What I loved the most the energy of the satff, always smiling and enthusiastic to help all patrons!

Definitely a place to have a quick bite - Ome will not be disappointed!

featured_reviews.name: Pulkit Daga
featured_reviews.review_text: Went here with a friend recently and I really liked the food. Halloumi Avocado Burger and Shakshouka are both definitely worth trying. All their desserts are eggless and really good. Worth a visit for sure!

featured_reviews.name: Nelwin D'cruz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Elementaria Bakery Cafe 🍰🍷

This outlet is located right opposite of Pheonix high street, lower Parel which takes about 10 minute to get there and is easy to locate.

The ambiance of the place is very pleasing to the eyes and I totally loved it. I would say it's a perfect place for a date 😉

The staff of the place was dressed smarty in their uniform, were polite and are happy to help if you need them. The service is quick too.

The menu consist of wide variety of salads, sandwiches, waffles, slushies, coolers, puff, croissant and a hell lot of cakes 😍😍😍

What I tried?

Black Rose box (Non veg)

The plate consist of Black rice, mix lettuces, pepper, beans, sweet potato, pomegranate, beetroot and a peri peri chicken on top looked very delicious and the portion would suffice for three or four person. Would recommend if you're more into salad.

Nutty apple

A simple delightful drink that's good anytime.

Chicken Ceaser Salad (Bread sandwich) 🥙

This sandwich activated my taste buds, its a perfect combination of chicken, lettuce, herbs and grilled bread. 😍

Tokyo mojito 😍

It's fizzy, lightly sweetened, minty lime and was refreshing.

Oreo Waffle 🍫

A classic delicious waffle with a chocolatey twist. This Oreo waffle for sure will make you come here for more.

AK 47 🍸
A Crunchy chocolate shake with creme and chocolate balls on it looked visually good and tasted delicious.

Kiwi Strawberry lemonade
😍
This is the best cooler I have tried till now a perfect blend of kiwi and strawberry with lemonade. Refreshing and perfect for summer!

Overall it was a great experience! Would definitely love to try more of the menu.

Food: 4.5/5

Service: 4.5/5

Ambiance: 4.5/5

featured_reviews.review_text:
Elementaria Cafe and Dessert Bar is located  exactly opposite the Phoenix Tower and is small yet conveniently comfortable bakery and dessert bar. Totally drool worthy sight to see Pastries, cupcakes, cookies, croissant on the display. For all you chocolate lovers who are looking for a quick fix whilst in Lower Parel head to Elementaria which is bang opposite Lower Parel.

Value for money, variety, cafe with privacy, friendly staff are some of this Cafe & Dessert Bar's highlight. Special mention to the staff of this place who are super co-operative.

What you should try here is the the season special Cheesecake Popsicle, 48 layer Chocolate Cake, Super Thick Shakes, Croissant and a variety of Cupcakes (recommend to check with the staff).

24 layer pastry-(Recommended) it’s an extremely delicious pastry with super soft layers of chocolaty cake and accompanied with icecream and chocolate sauce.

Minty Popsicle Cheesecake - The Christmas special range of desserts..!! The warmth of the cheesecake and the freshness of Mint topped with edible color pops.!!.

Caramel Sea Salt Milkshake, AK 47 Milkshake, Eli Jumbo (A super loaded dessert with ICe Cream, Chocolate Cake, Fresh Cream, Chocolate poppers, Wafer Sticks, Strawberry Jelly - Caution this is death by sweetness and for a serving for 2 people)

Definitely a place in my bookmark and to visit again list..!!
